title: Rotate PDF – Turn PDF Pages Free, No Upload | OpenAnyDoc
description: Rotate PDF pages in your browser: turn every page or only the ones you pick, left, right or upside down, and save. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Rotate PDF
subtitle: Turn every page, or only the pages you pick, and save the PDF; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Rotate PDF pages online and save the result permanently: turn every page, or only the pages you select, 90 degrees left, right or upside down. The thumbnails show the new orientation before you save, the page content is not re-encoded, and nothing is uploaded because the work happens in your browser.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: All pages or a few
features.text: Pick pages to turn, or pick none to turn them all; the thumbnails show the result before you save.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, the tool keeps working without an internet connection.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page. Its pages appear as thumbnails.

steps.title: Turn the pages
steps.text: Select pages, or none for all, then turn them left, right or upside down.

steps.title: Save and download
steps.text: Click Save rotated PDF, check the preview and download it.

handles: Scope: all pages, or only the pages you click.
Turns: 90 degrees left, 90 degrees right, or 180 degrees, as many times as you like.
Permanence: the rotation is saved in the PDF, so it opens turned in every PDF app.
Quality: only each page's rotation changes; text and pictures stay exactly as they were.
limits: PDFs that need a password to open can't be rotated; remove the password first.
Pages turn in steps of 90 degrees.
Very large PDFs are limited by your device's memory.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Is the rotation permanent?
faq.answer: Yes. The new PDF opens with the pages turned in every PDF app; your original file is not changed.

faq.question: Does rotating lower the quality?
faq.answer: No. Only the page's turn is changed; its text and pictures stay exactly as they were.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
